                if (!Array.from(dropdown.options).some(option => option.value === String(i))) {
                    var newOption = document.createElement("option");
                    newOption.value = i;
                    newOption.text = i;
                    dropdown.appendChild(newOption);
                }
            }
        }
        dropdown.value = ballNumber;
    }

            var apiHost = 'https://core-prod-origin.cricclubs.com/core/';

                    highlightsData = result.data;
                    updateHighlightLinks(highlightsData);
                }
            });

        function updateHighlightLinks(highlightsData) {
            const teams = Object.keys(highlightsData.playerHighlights)
            let players = [];
            teams.forEach(function(team) {
                players = highlightsData.playerHighlights[team]?.players;

                players.forEach(function (player) {
                    const playerId = player.playerId;
                    const videoLink = player.videoLink;

                    // Get the video element by player ID
                    const videoLinkElement = $("#btm_highlight_video_" + playerId);
                    console.log(videoLinkElement, playerId);

                    if (videoLinkElement.length > 0 && videoLink && videoLink !== "") {
                        let updatedLink;
                        // Format YouTube video link for embedding
                        if (videoLink.includes("youtube")) {
                            updatedLink = videoLink.replace("watch?v=", "embed/");
                        }

                        videoLinkElement.show().attr("href", updatedLink);
                        videoLinkElement.off("click").on("click", function (event) {
                            event.preventDefault();
                            let elm = 0;

                            if (updatedLink.includes("youtube")) {
                                $(".dialogOpenVideoLink").dialog("option", "title", `Player Highlights - Video(s)`);
                                document.getElementById("dialogOpenVideoLink").playSeq = true;
                                changeClicked = false;

                                if (document.getElementById("dialogOpenVideoLink").playSeq) {
                                    $("#playVideo")[0].src = updatedLink.replace("http:", "");
                                    $("#dialogOpenVideoLink").dialog("open");
                                }
                            } else {
                                $(".dialogOpenVideoHTML").dialog("option", "title", ` - Video(s)`);
                                const Player = document.getElementById("CCVideoPlayer");
                                Player.src = updatedLink;

                                Player.onended = function () {
                                    if (elm < nextsrc.length) {
                                        Player.src = nextsrc[elm];
                                        elm++;
                                        Player.play();
                                    } else {
                                        elm = 0; // Reset playlist
                                    }
                                };

                                $("#dialogOpenVideoHTML").dialog("open");
                                setTimeout(() => Player.play(), 500);

                                runningVideo = 0;
                                $(".circle-ball").css("background", "#26578b");
                                $("#ball_idx_" + runningVideo).css("background", "rgb(84, 154, 228)");
                            }

                        videoLinkElement.hide();
                    }
                });
            });
        }

            nextsrc = [];
            if (!listOfVideo) {
                return false;
            }
            const videoLink = listOfVideo[0].ballVideoLink;
            if (videoLink.includes('youtube')) {
                ballsOnVideoPlayerJQS = $("#ballCirclesInYoutube");

                ballsOnVideoPlayerJQS = $("#ballCirclesInVideoPlayer");

            playerId = parseInt(playerId);

                        pushBallDataToJQS(listOfVideo[i], videoSrcIdx);
                        videoSrcIdx = videoSrcIdx + 1;
                    }
                }

                document.getElementById("dialogOpenVideoLink").playSeq = true;

                Player.onended = function () {
                    if (elm < nextsrc.length) {

                        elm = elm + 1;

                $("#dialogOpenVideoHTML").dialog("open");

                runningVideo = 0;
                $(".circle-ball").css("background", "#26578b");
                $("#ball_idx_" + runningVideo + "").css("background", "rgb(84, 154, 228)");
            }
        }

        function playYoutubeVideo(videoIndex, isChanged) {
            if (document.getElementById("dialogOpenVideoLink").playSeq) {
                if (videoIndex < nextsrc.length && (isChanged || (!isChanged && !changeClicked))) {
                    const videoLink = nextsrc[videoIndex];
                    const params = videoLink.split('?')[1].split('&')
                    const start = params[0].split('=')[1];
                    const end = params[1].split('=')[1];
                    const elapsed = end - start;
                    $(".circle-ball").css("background", "#26578b");
                    $("#ball_idx_" + videoIndex).css("background-color", "#8b262e");
                    console.log("playing video " + videoIndex + " - " + videoLink + "-" + elapsed);
                    $("#playVideo")[0].src = videoLink.replace("http:", "");
                    $("#dialogOpenVideoLink").dialog("open");
                    setTimeout(function () {
                        if (isChanged || !changeClicked) {
                            $("#ball_idx_" + videoIndex + "").css("background", "#26578b");
                            playYoutubeVideo(++videoIndex, isChanged);
                        }
                    }, elapsed * 1000);
                }
            }
        }

        function extractVideoId(url) {
            let videoId = null;
            let patterns = [
                /youtube\.com\/watch\?v=([^&]+)/,          // Standard YouTube URL
                /youtube\.com\/embed\/([^?&]+)/,          // Embedded URL
                /youtu\.be\/([^?&]+)/,                    // Shortened URL
                /youtube\.com\/v\/([^?&]+)/,              // Alternate URL
                /youtube\.com\/tv#\/watch\/video\/([^?&]+)/, // YouTube TV
                /m\.youtube\.com\/watch\?v=([^&]+)/       // Mobile YouTube URL
            ];

            for (let pattern of patterns) {
                let match = url.match(pattern);
                if (match && match[1]) {
                    videoId = match[1];
                    break;
                }
            }

            return videoId;
        }

          Here are the numbers (paper width and height) that I found to work.
          It still creates a little overlap part between the pages, but good enough for me.
          if you can find an official number from jsPDF, use them.
          */
                    var imgWidth = 210;
                    var pageHeight = 295;
                    var imgHeight = canvas.height * imgWidth / canvas.width;
                    var heightLeft = imgHeight;

                    var doc = new jsPDF('p', 'mm');
                    var position = 0;
                    doc.addImage(canvasImg, 'PNG', 0, position, imgWidth, imgHeight);

                    while (heightLeft >= 0) {
                        position = heightLeft - imgHeight;
                        doc.addPage();
                        doc.addImage(canvasImg, 'PNG', 0, position, imgWidth, imgHeight);
                        heightLeft -= pageHeight;

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        $("#dialog-confirm").dialog({
            resizable: false,
            autoOpen: false,
            modal: true,
            buttons: {
                "Delete": function () {
                    var matchId = $("#deleteId").val();
                    var ajaxUrl = '/HoustonPremierT20League/deleteMatch.do?clubId=1366&matchId=' + matchId;
                    $.ajax({
                        url: ajaxUrl,
                        success: function (result) {
                            $('#displyMessage').html("scorecard deleted");
                            $('#displyMessage').dialog("open");
                            window.location = '/HoustonPremierT20League/listMatches.do?clubId=1366';
                        }
                    });
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                },
                Cancel: function () {
                    var matchId = $("#deleteId").val();
                    //$("#deleteButton"+matchId).button( "enable" );
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                }
            }
        });

        $("#displyMessage").dialog({
            autoOpen: false,
            modal: true
        });

        $("#dialog-confirm1").dialog({
            resizable: false,
            autoOpen: false,
            modal: true,
            buttons: {
                "Lock": function () {
                    var matchId = $("#lockId").val();
                    var ajaxUrl = '/HoustonPremierT20League/lockMatch.do?clubId=1366&matchId=' + matchId;
                    $.ajax({
                        url: ajaxUrl, success: function (result) {
                            if (result == 'success') {
                                $("#lockLink" + matchId).attr('href', "javascript:unLockMatch(" + matchId + ",\"" + $("#lockMessage").html() + "\");");
                                $("#lockLink" + matchId).text('Unlock');
                                // $(".linkAsButton").button();
                            } else {
                                alert("We could not process your request please contact support@cricclubs.com");
                            }

                        }
                    });
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                },
                Cancel: function () {
                    var matchId = $("#lockId").val();
                    // $("#lockButton"+matchId).button( "enable" );
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                }
            }
        });

        $("#dialog-confirm2").dialog({
            resizable: false,
            autoOpen: false,
            modal: true,
            buttons: {
                "UnLock": function () {
                    var matchId = $("#unLockId").val();
                    var ajaxUrl = '/HoustonPremierT20League/unLockMatch.do?clubId=1366&matchId=' + matchId;
                    $.ajax({
                        url: ajaxUrl, success: function (result) {

                            if (result == 'success') {
                                $("#lockLink" + matchId).attr("href", "javascript:lockMatch(" + matchId + ",\"" + $("#unLockMessage").html() + "\");");
                                $("#lockLink" + matchId).text('Lock');
                                //$(".linkAsButton").button();
                            } else {
                                alert("We could not process your request please contact support@cricclubs.com");
                            }

                        }
                    });
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                },
                Cancel: function () {
                    var matchId = $("#unLockId").val();
                    // $("#unLockButton"+matchId).button( "enable" );
                    $(this).dialog("close");
                }
            }
        });

    });

    function deleteMatch(matchId, name) {

        //$("#deleteButton"+matchId).button( "disable" );
        $("#deleteMessage").html(name);
        $("#deleteId").val(matchId);
        $("#dialog-confirm").dialog("open");
    }

    function lockMatch(matchId, name) {

        //$("#lockButton"+matchId).button( "disable" );
        $("#lockMessage").html(name);
        $("#lockId").val(matchId);
        $("#dialog-confirm1").dialog("open");
    }

    function unLockMatch(matchId, name) {

        //$("#unLockButton"+matchId).button( "disable" );
        $("#unLockMessage").html(name);
        $("#unLockId").val(matchId);
        $("#dialog-confirm2").dialog("open");
    }

    function loadView(view) {
        //$('#loading').dialog('open');
        var currentURL = window.location.href;
        var queryString = currentURL.substring(currentURL.indexOf('?'));
        window.location.href = '/HoustonPremierT20League/' + view + '.do' + queryString;

    }

</script>

        var listOfVideo = [];

        function loadVideoHighlightsData(matchId, clubId) {
            var apiHost = 'https://core-prod-origin.cricclubs.com/core/';
            var ajaxUrl = apiHost + "highlights/videoLinks?clubId=" + clubId + "&matchId=" + matchId;
            $.ajax({
                url: ajaxUrl,
                headers: {
                    "Content-Type": "application/json",
                    "x-consumer-key": "9e9L7i5Te",
                    "x-api-key": "Et5I7L9E9"
                },
                success: function (result) {
                    highlightsData = result.data;
                    updateHighlightLinks(highlightsData);
                }
            });
        }

        function updateHighlightLinks(highlightsData) {
            const teams = Object.keys(highlightsData.playerHighlights)
            let players = [];
            teams.forEach(function(team) {
                players = highlightsData.playerHighlights[team]?.players;

                players.forEach(function (player) {
                    const playerId = player.playerId;
                    const videoLink = player.videoLink;

                    // Get the video element by player ID
                    const videoLinkElement = $("#btm_highlight_video_" + playerId);
                    console.log(videoLinkElement, playerId);

                    if (videoLinkElement.length > 0 && videoLink && videoLink !== "") {
                        let updatedLink;
                        // Format YouTube video link for embedding
                        if (videoLink.includes("youtube")) {
                            updatedLink = videoLink.replace("watch?v=", "embed/");
                        }

                        videoLinkElement.show().attr("href", updatedLink);
                        videoLinkElement.off("click").on("click", function (event) {
                            event.preventDefault();
                            let elm = 0;

                            if (updatedLink.includes("youtube")) {
                                $(".dialogOpenVideoLink").dialog("option", "title", `Player Highlights - Video(s)`);
                                document.getElementById("dialogOpenVideoLink").playSeq = true;
                                changeClicked = false;

                                if (document.getElementById("dialogOpenVideoLink").playSeq) {
                                    $("#playVideo")[0].src = updatedLink.replace("http:", "");
                                    $("#dialogOpenVideoLink").dialog("open");

        function extractVideoId(url) {
            let videoId = null;
            let patterns = [
                /youtube\.com\/watch\?v=([^&]+)/,          // Standard YouTube URL
                /youtube\.com\/embed\/([^?&]+)/,          // Embedded URL
                /youtu\.be\/([^?&]+)/,                    // Shortened URL
                /youtube\.com\/v\/([^?&]+)/,              // Alternate URL
                /youtube\.com\/tv#\/watch\/video\/([^?&]+)/, // YouTube TV
                /m\.youtube\.com\/watch\?v=([^&]+)/       // Mobile YouTube URL
            ];

            for (let pattern of patterns) {
                let match = url.match(pattern);
                if (match && match[1]) {
                    videoId = match[1];
                    break;
                }
            }

            return videoId;
        }
